verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a documented, programmatic Management API (OpenAPI spec at openapi.json), an auto-generated REST/GraphQL data API from every project, a headless CLI (probe-confirmed runnable via npx), and an OAuth-gated remote MCP server with granular scopes — all explicitly positioned for AI-native/agent consumption via llms.txt and the ai-tools docs. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of the Management API itself (beyond MCP) and any hands-on failure/success report specifically exercising the OpenAPI-driven Management API end-to-end.
